executive_summary.headline: Strong January—exceeded conversion and efficiency targets while scaling budget 17%
executive_summary.what_drove_results: New UGC creative drove 25% better efficiency than previous content. Post-holiday competition lull provided favorable CPMs. Budget increase absorbed well by expanded LAL audiences.
executive_summary.outlook: February should maintain momentum. Planning to scale top UGC creative further and test additional creators.

goal_tracking.commentary: All performance targets exceeded while coming in slightly under budget. This indicates room to scale further next month.

month_over_month.narrative: January delivered strong results across all metrics. Despite a 17% budget increase, CPA decreased 7% and conversions grew 25%—meaning we scaled efficiently. The UGC creative refresh was the primary driver, with new content outperforming previous ads by significant margins. CPM increased 13%, which is expected when scaling, but strong CTR improvements offset this cost increase.
